lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [excited, hushed] What if you had... admin commands? In real life?
lines.text: What if you had... admin commands? In real life?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [playful] You type it in the chat... and it just... happens.
lines.text: You type it in the chat... and it just... happens.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [fast, playful] Your dad is in orbit. Your granny is faster than sound. And your cat... is the size of a building.
lines.text: Your dad is in orbit. Your granny is faster than sound. And your cat... is the size of a building.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [nervous laugh] Okay. Okay! I can fix this. Un... fly... everyone...
lines.text: Okay. Okay! I can fix this. Un... fly... everyone...

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [panicked] Permission DENIED?! But I'm the admin!
lines.text: Permission DENIED?! But I'm the admin!

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [booming, echoing] No. [pause] I am.
lines.text: No. I am.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] Yeah. Things got a little... out of hand. [pause] Let's go back to Monday.
lines.text: Yeah. Things got a little... out of hand. Let's go back to Monday.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [storyteller] This is you. Twelve years old. Totally normal. [pause] Maybe a little... too normal.
lines.text: This is you. Twelve years old. Totally normal. Maybe a little... too normal.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You get picked last in gym. Every time. Even after the kid with the broken arm.
lines.text: You get picked last in gym. Every time. Even after the kid with the broken arm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: In every obby, you die on the first jump. [pause] Even in "Easy Obby for Babies."
lines.text: In every obby, you die on the first jump. Even in "Easy Obby for Babies."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [frustrated] That lava came out of NOWHERE!
lines.text: That lava came out of NOWHERE!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] It was the floor. The whole floor was lava. It said so in the name.
lines.text: It was the floor. The whole floor was lava. It said so in the name.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: At home, there's Dad. He works from home. Mostly by asking if people can hear him.
lines.text: At home, there's Dad. He works from home. Mostly by asking if people can hear him.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [loud, into the headset] Can you hear me now? [pause] How about now? [pause] NOW?
lines.text: Can you hear me now? How about now? NOW?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: There's Mom. She runs the whole house with sticky notes.
lines.text: There's Mom. She runs the whole house with sticky notes.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [cheerful, firm] Room. Clean. Today. [pause] I put it on a sticky note, so it's official.
lines.text: Room. Clean. Today. I put it on a sticky note, so it's official.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: There's Granny. She is ninety-one, and she still drives to the store... at four miles an hour.
lines.text: There's Granny. She is ninety-one, and she still drives to the store... at four miles an hour.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.raw: [sweet, slow] I like to... enjoy... the journey, sweetie.
lines.text: I like to... enjoy... the journey, sweetie.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And there's Pancake. The laziest cat in the world. He moves twice a day. [pause] Both times to sit on your keyboard.
lines.text: And there's Pancake. The laziest cat in the world. He moves twice a day. Both times to sit on your keyboard.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: At school, there's Zoe. Your best friend. She knows everything about computers... and she's not afraid to tell you.
lines.text: At school, there's Zoe. Your best friend. She knows everything about computers... and she's not afraid to tell you.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [sarcastic] You wrote your password on a sticky note. On your monitor. Facing the window.
lines.text: You wrote your password on a sticky note. On your monitor. Facing the window.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [defensive] It's a SECRET sticky note!
lines.text: It's a SECRET sticky note!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And then... there's Brick.
lines.text: And then... there's Brick.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [slow, smug] Lunch money. [pause] Also your cookie. [pause] Also your OTHER cookie.
lines.text: Lunch money. Also your cookie. Also your OTHER cookie.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [trying to be brave] No! [pause] ...Okay. Here. Have both cookies.
lines.text: No! ...Okay. Here. Have both cookies.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [deadpan] Very brave. Very strong. [pause] Truly a legend.
lines.text: Very brave. Very strong. Truly a legend.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: At night, you dream about being someone else. Someone strong. Someone fast. [pause] Someone who never gets picked last.
lines.text: At night, you dream about being someone else. Someone strong. Someone fast. Someone who never gets picked last.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [sighs] Yeah. It was a normal Monday. [pause] Until the garage sale.
lines.text: Yeah. It was a normal Monday. Until the garage sale.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: On the way home, you see a garage sale you've never seen before. On a street you've never seen before.
lines.text: On the way home, you see a garage sale you've never seen before. On a street you've never seen before.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [reading] "Server Street"? [pause] Since when do we have a Server Street?
lines.text: "Server Street"? Since when do we have a Server Street?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And a very old man... who looks at you like he's been waiting.
lines.text: And a very old man... who looks at you like he's been waiting.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [creaky, mysterious] Ahh. Finally. [pause] You'll want the laptop.
lines.text: Ahh. Finally. You'll want the laptop.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [confused] I didn't say anything.
lines.text: I didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [mysterious] One dollar. No refunds. [pause] And no questions.
lines.text: One dollar. No refunds. And no questions.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: Why does it say "do not type"?
lines.text: Why does it say "do not type"?

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [smiling] That was a question.
lines.text: That was a question.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [whispers] Oh, and one more thing... [pause] It's not a game.
lines.text: Oh, and one more thing... It's not a game.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You turn around to get your dollar... and the whole garage sale is gone.
lines.text: You turn around to get your dollar... and the whole garage sale is gone.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [nervous] Cool. Cool cool cool. [pause] Totally normal neighborhood.
lines.text: Cool. Cool cool cool. Totally normal neighborhood.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: At home, the laptop has no apps. No games. Just one black screen... that knows your name.
lines.text: At home, the laptop has no apps. No games. Just one black screen... that knows your name.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm, robotic] Admin panel loaded. Welcome... you.
lines.text: Admin panel loaded. Welcome... you.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispers] It knows my username.
lines.text: It knows my username.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispers] Pancake. Not now. [pause] This is a very spooky moment.
lines.text: Pancake. Not now. This is a very spooky moment.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: So you do what anyone would do. You type "help."
lines.text: So you do what anyone would do. You type "help."

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: Available commands: Fly. Speed. Size. Jail. Teleport. God mode. Noclip. Freeze. [pause] Kick.
lines.text: Available commands: Fly. Speed. Size. Jail. Teleport. God mode. Noclip. Freeze. Kick.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [laughs] Admin commands. Like in a game. [pause] So, as a joke... you type: "fly me."
lines.text: Admin commands. Like in a game. So, as a joke... you type: "fly me."

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [shocked, then excited] I'm— I'm FLYING! I'm actually— [bonk] OW. Ceiling. There's a ceiling.
lines.text: I'm— I'm FLYING! I'm actually— OW. Ceiling. There's a ceiling.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The next morning... you start testing.
lines.text: The next morning... you start testing.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Granny has been making one pancake. For forty minutes.
lines.text: Granny has been making one pancake. For forty minutes.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispers, typing] Speed... Granny.
lines.text: Speed... Granny.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.raw: [very fast, delighted] Oh my! Oh my! I made four hundred pancakes, sweetie! Want to go to the store? I'll drive!
lines.text: Oh my! Oh my! I made four hundred pancakes, sweetie! Want to go to the store? I'll drive!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [worried] Granny wanted to drive. At nine hundred miles an hour.
lines.text: Granny wanted to drive. At nine hundred miles an hour.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [quickly] Un-speed Granny! UN-SPEED GRANNY!
lines.text: Un-speed Granny! UN-SPEED GRANNY!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Next... the cat.
lines.text: Next... the cat.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: Size... Pancake... [pause] ten.
lines.text: Size... Pancake... ten.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [panicked] Ten was too much. Ten was VERY much.
lines.text: Ten was too much. Ten was VERY much.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: Size Pancake ONE! ONE!
lines.text: Size Pancake ONE! ONE!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Then you got hungry. But the fridge was SO far away.
lines.text: Then you got hungry. But the fridge was SO far away.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [lazy] Teleport me... to the fridge.
lines.text: Teleport me... to the fridge.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [muffled] ...I said TO the fridge. Not IN the fridge.
lines.text: ...I said TO the fridge. Not IN the fridge.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And Dad. Dad was in a very important meeting.
lines.text: And Dad. Dad was in a very important meeting.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [into the headset] Can you hear me now? Sir? Sir, can you—
lines.text: Can you hear me now? Sir? Sir, can you—

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispers, mischievous] Fly... Dad.
lines.text: Fly... Dad.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.raw: [confused, on the call] Dave... are you... outside? Are you... above a tree?
lines.text: Dave... are you... outside? Are you... above a tree?

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [panicking, then pretending] I'm— I'm working from... the sky office! [pause] Can you hear me now?
lines.text: I'm— I'm working from... the sky office! Can you hear me now?

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.raw: [amazed] Yes! Perfectly! [pause] First time in three years!
lines.text: Yes! Perfectly! First time in three years!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: God mode. Me.
lines.text: God mode. Me.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [confused] Why... won't my sticky notes stick?
lines.text: Why... won't my sticky notes stick?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You called Zoe. She was there in four minutes.
lines.text: You called Zoe. She was there in four minutes.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [stunned, then serious] That's a real admin panel. Like, a REAL one. For... real life.
lines.text: That's a real admin panel. Like, a REAL one. For... real life.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [fast, explaining] In games, admins can do anything. Fly. Teleport. Ban people. They're basically... the boss of the server.
lines.text: In games, admins can do anything. Fly. Teleport. Ban people. They're basically... the boss of the server.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [slowly realizing] So I'm the boss... of real life?
lines.text: So I'm the boss... of real life?

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [serious] Listen to me. Admin panels have logs. Every command gets saved. Somebody, somewhere... can see what you type.
lines.text: Listen to me. Admin panels have logs. Every command gets saved. Somebody, somewhere... can see what you type.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [cocky] Relax. What could possibly go wrong?
lines.text: Relax. What could possibly go wrong?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [ominous] Famous last words.
lines.text: Famous last words.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The next day, you take the laptop to school.
lines.text: The next day, you take the laptop to school.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [slow, smug] Move, noob. Lunch money.
lines.text: Move, noob. Lunch money.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [smirks, typing] Jail... Brick.
lines.text: Jail... Brick.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [confused] Hey! Who put a CAGE on me?!
lines.text: Hey! Who put a CAGE on me?!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [proud] For the first time ever, Brick was the one who couldn't move.
lines.text: For the first time ever, Brick was the one who couldn't move.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: Teleport me... to the front of the line.
lines.text: Teleport me... to the front of the line.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Gym class. The mile run.
lines.text: Gym class. The mile run.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispers] Speed me.
lines.text: Speed me.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You ran the mile in zero point three seconds. [pause] Your shoes did not survive.
lines.text: You ran the mile in zero point three seconds. Your shoes did not survive.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.raw: [stunned] That's... a new world record. [pause] Also... where are your shoes?
lines.text: That's... a new world record. Also... where are your shoes?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Math test. You didn't study.
lines.text: Math test. You didn't study.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [typing] Noclip... me.
lines.text: Noclip... me.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Noclip lets you walk through walls. [pause] It does NOT let you choose which wall.
lines.text: Noclip lets you walk through walls. It does NOT let you choose which wall.

lines.speaker: PRINCIPAL
lines.raw: [slow, unimpressed] Young man. [pause] Did you just walk through my wall?
lines.text: Young man. Did you just walk through my wall?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [nervous] ...No? [pause] Noclip... me... AWAY!
lines.text: ...No? Noclip... me... AWAY!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: By lunch... you were the most popular kid in school.
lines.text: By lunch... you were the most popular kid in school.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Everybody wanted a command. And you said yes. To everybody.
lines.text: Everybody wanted a command. And you said yes. To everybody.

lines.speaker: KID
lines.raw: [excited] Make me fly! [pause] No, wait, make me GIANT! [pause] No, wait, BOTH!
lines.text: Make me fly! No, wait, make me GIANT! No, wait, BOTH!

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [worried] Stop. Please. The logs. Somebody is going to notice.
lines.text: Stop. Please. The logs. Somebody is going to notice.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [laughs] Zoe. Relax. Nobody reads the logs.
lines.text: Zoe. Relax. Nobody reads the logs.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [whispers] Somebody... reads the logs.
lines.text: Somebody... reads the logs.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Saturday. You decide to think bigger.
lines.text: Saturday. You decide to think bigger.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [excited] Fly... ALL!
lines.text: Fly... ALL!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The whole town took off. Including the mailman. Including a bus. [pause] Including a guy who was in the bath.
lines.text: The whole town took off. Including the mailman. Including a bus. Including a guy who was in the bath.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Then you wanted to make Pancake big again. Just a little. [pause] But you made a typo.
lines.text: Then you wanted to make Pancake big again. Just a little. But you made a typo.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm] Command: size... all cats. One hundred.
lines.text: Command: size... all cats. One hundred.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [stunned] Every cat in the city. [pause] One hundred times bigger.
lines.text: Every cat in the city. One hundred times bigger.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [laughing, drunk on power] I'm the king of the city! [pause] I'm the ADMIN OF EVERYTHING!
lines.text: I'm the king of the city! I'm the ADMIN OF EVERYTHING!

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [alarmed] Your log is nine thousand lines long! Somebody is DEFINITELY reading it!
lines.text: Your log is nine thousand lines long! Somebody is DEFINITELY reading it!

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [dramatic] Breaking news! The city is flying! Grandmas are breaking the sound barrier! And a giant cat is sitting... on the mayor.
lines.text: Breaking news! The city is flying! Grandmas are breaking the sound barrier! And a giant cat is sitting... on the mayor.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [worried] Experts are asking one question. [pause] Who is doing this?
lines.text: Experts are asking one question. Who is doing this?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [nervous, typing fast] Okay! I'll fix it! Un-fly all! Size all cats... one!
lines.text: Okay! I'll fix it! Un-fly all! Size all cats... one!

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [cold] Permission denied. [pause] Permission denied. [pause] Your admin rights... are under review.
lines.text: Permission denied. Permission denied. Your admin rights... are under review.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [hushed] And that's when the sky... cracked.
lines.text: And that's when the sky... cracked.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Out of the crack came... a chat message. [pause] The biggest chat message you've ever seen.
lines.text: Out of the crack came... a chat message. The biggest chat message you've ever seen.

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [booming] Who. Gave you. Admin?
lines.text: Who. Gave you. Admin?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [tiny voice] ...A garage sale?
lines.text: ...A garage sale?

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [booming] You flew a bus. You jailed a child. You made one hundred thousand cats... GIANT.
lines.text: You flew a bus. You jailed a child. You made one hundred thousand cats... GIANT.

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [booming] Your log is longer... than my beard.
lines.text: Your log is longer... than my beard.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [nervous] In my defense... the cats look really happy.
lines.text: In my defense... the cats look really happy.

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [cold, booming] Un-fly. All.
lines.text: Un-fly. All.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Everyone fell at the same time. [pause] Lucky for them... cats are VERY good at catching things.
lines.text: Everyone fell at the same time. Lucky for them... cats are VERY good at catching things.

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [booming] And now... you. [pause] Kick.
lines.text: And now... you. Kick.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [panicked] No no no— God mode! GOD MODE ME!
lines.text: No no no— God mode! GOD MODE ME!

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [surprised, then angry] You... dare... use god mode... against an ADMIN?
lines.text: You... dare... use god mode... against an ADMIN?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [hushed] And that's how the first admin battle in history began.
lines.text: And that's how the first admin battle in history began.

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [booming] Freeze.
lines.text: Freeze.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: He froze you solid.
lines.text: He froze you solid.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.raw: [very fast, cheerful] Hold still, sweetie! Granny's got a hair dryer!
lines.text: Hold still, sweetie! Granny's got a hair dryer!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [teeth chattering] Th-thanks, Granny! Teleport... me... away!
lines.text: Th-thanks, Granny! Teleport... me... away!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You teleported to the desert. He was there. [pause] To the ocean. He was there. [pause] To the top of a mountain. [pause] He was there... with a snack.
lines.text: You teleported to the desert. He was there. To the ocean. He was there. To the top of a mountain. He was there... with a snack.

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [calm] Teleport is my command. [pause] I invented it.
lines.text: Teleport is my command. I invented it.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [typing fast] Jail... Admin!
lines.text: Jail... Admin!

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [calm] Un-jail me. [pause] Jail YOU.
lines.text: Un-jail me. Jail YOU.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [frustrated] Un-jail me! [pause] Jail you! [pause] UN-JAIL ME!
lines.text: Un-jail me! Jail you! UN-JAIL ME!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] This went on for eleven minutes.
lines.text: This went on for eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [typing furiously] Fine! Size me... one hundred!
lines.text: Fine! Size me... one hundred!

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [unimpressed] Size me... one thousand.
lines.text: Size me... one thousand.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] He always had a bigger number.
lines.text: He always had a bigger number.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [heroic] Nobody messes with my kid! [pause] Can you hear me now?!
lines.text: Nobody messes with my kid! Can you hear me now?!

lines.speaker: ADMIN
lines.raw: [annoyed, booming] Yes! I can hear you! Everybody can hear you!
lines.text: Yes! I can hear you! Everybody can hear you!

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [focused] I'm in his logs! He's not a program... he's a PERSON. He's typing from somewhere REAL!
lines.text: I'm in his logs! He's not a program... he's a PERSON. He's typing from somewhere REAL!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [determined] Then I'm going there. [pause] Teleport me... to the Admin!
lines.text: Then I'm going there. Teleport me... to the Admin!

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [warning] Warning. Battery... three percent.
lines.text: Warning. Battery... three percent.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [shouting] TELEPORT ME TO THE ADMIN!
lines.text: TELEPORT ME TO THE ADMIN!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You land in a small, warm room. Full of screens. Every screen... a different city. Every city... live.
lines.text: You land in a small, warm room. Full of screens. Every screen... a different city. Every city... live.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And in the big chair... is a very old man. [pause] The old man from the garage sale.
lines.text: And in the big chair... is a very old man. The old man from the garage sale.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [tired, gentle] Ah. You found the server room. [pause] Sit down. Would you like some tea?
lines.text: Ah. You found the server room. Sit down. Would you like some tea?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [stunned] YOU'RE the Admin?! You SOLD me the laptop!
lines.text: YOU'RE the Admin?! You SOLD me the laptop!

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [chuckles] Every hundred years, I give the panel to one person. To see what they do with it.
lines.text: Every hundred years, I give the panel to one person. To see what they do with it.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [confused] Every hundred YEARS? How old ARE you?
lines.text: Every hundred YEARS? How old ARE you?

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [proud] I've been the admin since the very first player joined. [pause] A very confused dinosaur.
lines.text: I've been the admin since the very first player joined. A very confused dinosaur.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [sighs] Most people want to fly. Be fast. Be big. Win.
lines.text: Most people want to fly. Be fast. Be big. Win.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [chuckles] One fellow in nineteen sixty-four made himself nine feet tall. [pause] He couldn't fit through any doors. He was very sad.
lines.text: One fellow in nineteen sixty-four made himself nine feet tall. He couldn't fit through any doors. He was very sad.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [quiet] ...That's exactly what I did.
lines.text: ...That's exactly what I did.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [gentle] I know. I read the logs. [pause] Every single one.
lines.text: I know. I read the logs. Every single one.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [kind] And you never once typed a command... to help somebody else.
lines.text: And you never once typed a command... to help somebody else.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [quiet] And he was right.
lines.text: And he was right.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm] Battery... one percent.
lines.text: Battery... one percent.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [gentle] Now I'll type "undo all." Everything goes back. Including you.
lines.text: Now I'll type "undo all." Everything goes back. Including you.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [urgent] Wait! [pause] Let me fix it. Myself. One by one.
lines.text: Wait! Let me fix it. Myself. One by one.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: So you go back. [pause] With the old man's spare charger. And a cup of tea.
lines.text: So you go back. With the old man's spare charger. And a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [careful] Size... all cats... one.
lines.text: Size... all cats... one.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: Un-fly... the bus.
lines.text: Un-fly... the bus.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You bring back every flying thing. Every giant thing. Every Granny. [pause] Well. Almost every Granny.
lines.text: You bring back every flying thing. Every giant thing. Every Granny. Well. Almost every Granny.

lines.speaker: GRANNY
lines.raw: [delighted] Leave me fast, sweetie! I've never been early before!
lines.text: Leave me fast, sweetie! I've never been early before!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [touched] A sticky note? [pause] From YOU? [pause] Oh, it's official now.
lines.text: A sticky note? From YOU? Oh, it's official now.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And then... Brick.
lines.text: And then... Brick.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [quiet, embarrassed] ...Are you gonna leave me in here?
lines.text: ...Are you gonna leave me in here?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [softly] Un-jail Brick. [pause] Hey. Why do you always take my lunch?
lines.text: Un-jail Brick. Hey. Why do you always take my lunch?

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [small, sad] ...Because then you have to talk to me. [pause] Nobody else does.
lines.text: ...Because then you have to talk to me. Nobody else does.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [softly] Oh.
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [warm] You know you could just... sit with us?
lines.text: You know you could just... sit with us?

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [hopeful, gruff] ...Can I still have the cookie?
lines.text: ...Can I still have the cookie?

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [laughs] HALF the cookie.
lines.text: HALF the cookie.

lines.speaker: BRICK
lines.raw: [smiling for the first time] ...Deal.
lines.text: ...Deal.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [warm] One last thing. The panel can keep one command for you. Forever. Any command you want.
lines.text: One last thing. The panel can keep one command for you. Forever. Any command you want.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You could be fast forever. Big forever. Never picked last again.
lines.text: You could be fast forever. Big forever. Never picked last again.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You think about it... for a long time.
lines.text: You think about it... for a long time.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm] Admin rights... removed. [pause] Thanks for playing.
lines.text: Admin rights... removed. Thanks for playing.

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [proud, warm] Hm. [pause] In two thousand years... you're only the second person to type that.
lines.text: Hm. In two thousand years... you're only the second person to type that.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [curious] Who was the first?
lines.text: Who was the first?

lines.speaker: OLDMAN
lines.raw: [winks] Me.
lines.text: Me.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: The next morning, everything is normal. [pause] Mostly.
lines.text: The next morning, everything is normal. Mostly.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You still get picked last in gym. [pause] Except now Brick is team captain. [pause] And he picks you first.
lines.text: You still get picked last in gym. Except now Brick is team captain. And he picks you first.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [into the headset] Can you hear me now? [pause] ...I miss the sky office.
lines.text: Can you hear me now? ...I miss the sky office.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Granny is still fast. She's never been late again. [pause] She also walks to the store... faster than the car.
lines.text: Granny is still fast. She's never been late again. She also walks to the store... faster than the car.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: Zoe checks your monitor every day.
lines.text: Zoe checks your monitor every day.

lines.speaker: ZOE
lines.raw: [deadpan] Your password sticky note is still facing the window.
lines.text: Your password sticky note is still facing the window.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [proud] Yeah. But now it says "nice try."
lines.text: Yeah. But now it says "nice try."

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: And Pancake still sits on your keyboard. [pause] But now... when he does...
lines.text: And Pancake still sits on your keyboard. But now... when he does...

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm] Command accepted.
lines.text: Command accepted.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [whispers, horrified] ...PANCAKE.
lines.text: ...PANCAKE.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [deadpan] The panel didn't keep one command. [pause] It kept one admin.
lines.text: The panel didn't keep one command. It kept one admin.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [warm, to camera] So... if YOU had admin commands... what would you type first? Tell us in the comments!
lines.text: So... if YOU had admin commands... what would you type first? Tell us in the comments!

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [to camera] And remember: with great commands... comes great... [pause] cat problems.
lines.text: And remember: with great commands... comes great... cat problems.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [panicked, turning around] Pancake! Put. The laptop. DOWN!
lines.text: Pancake! Put. The laptop. DOWN!
